protected_assets.description: Project filesystem and exact Project identity boundary
User Skill and Capability inventory integrity
Runtime catalog and immutable Skill content identity

trusted_assumptions.description: Developer account, OS kernel and system absolute-path tools are trusted
Existing Capability Manager, permission gate and durable stores enforce their documented contracts
GitHub HTTPS transport and resolved public repository revision are trusted inputs after validation

in_scope_failures.description: Agent cannot discover the official installer and falls back to shell directory guessing
Installed files are not published into the managed runtime catalog
Project-scoped installation leaks into another Project or user-global scope
Malformed or malicious repository content escapes staging validation
Batch, retry or confirmation replay leaves partial or duplicate durable state
UI or model claims success before receipt, catalog refresh and runtime resolution

in_scope_adversaries.description: Untrusted public Skill repository attempting path traversal, symlink or manifest abuse
LLM output attempting to bypass typed installation through generic shell actions

out_of_scope_conditions.description: Private GitHub repository authentication and credential lifecycle
Hostile host, compromised developer account or compromised OS kernel
Non-GitHub Skill distribution sources and marketplace recommendation quality

maximum_acceptable_impact: A failed attempt may leave bounded removable staging and a durable failure receipt, but must not modify Project source files, publish partial runtime capability state, or affect another Project.
